meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Acne-prone skin ke liye **₹700 ke andar sabse practical choice: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** hai—especially agar blackheads, whiteheads ya oily skin hai. Iski price offers ke hisaab se lagbhag ₹224–₹521 mil rahi hai.[1][5][8]

### Skin concern ke hisaab se options

- **Active pimples, blackheads/whiteheads:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum ya The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Serum — lagbhag ₹182–₹521.[1][5]
- **Oily skin, mild acne aur large-looking pores:** The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Serum — lagbhag ₹187–₹222.[1][5]
- **Acne ke baad dark marks:** Derma Decode 10% Azelaic Acid + 1% Kojic Acid — lagbhag ₹587; ya Minimalist Alpha Arbutin 2% — lagbhag ₹224.[1][5]
- **Sensitive skin:** 5% niacinamide serum se start karein, jaise Minimalist 5% Niacinamide + HA; price roughly ₹399–₹569.[7]

**Meri recommendation:**  
Agar pimples abhi ho rahe hain, **2% salicylic acid serum** lein. Raat mein clean, dry skin par **2–3 drops, alternate nights** lagayein; uske baad moisturiser. Ek saath salicylic acid, retinol, vitamin C aur multiple serums na milayein—irritation badh sakti hai.[3]

Subah **SPF 30+ sunscreen** zaroor lagayein. Pehle patch test karein; burning, severe redness ya peeling ho to band kar dein. Bahut painful/cystic acne ya 8–12 hafton mein improvement na ho, dermatologist ko dikhana better hai.[3]
